feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: U.S. envoys in Moscow in new push for peace between Russia and Ukraine
entry.summary: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner have arrived in Moscow to revive efforts to end Russia's invasion of Ukraine. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has called for a halt to air attacks during their visit, but Moscow has not publicly responded.

entry.title: If you prefer puzzles to doomscrolling, here are 5 great games to check out
entry.summary: NPR's Linda Holmes is a daily puzzle devotee. She recommends games that will test your knowledge of geography, history, and even the most obscure corners of Wikipedia.

entry.title: 40 years later, 'The Baby-Sitters Club' is still helping readers see themselves
entry.summary: Ann M. Martin's beloved series has influenced generations of readers. We're still asking: Which babysitter are you?

entry.title: Voters are fed up with data centers. Both parties are trying to cash in for midterms
entry.summary: Democrats and Republicans have found common ground in this campaign season. Both parties have poured millions into ads attacking data centers as the public continues to protest the AI facilities.

entry.title: Flock cameras draw opposition from across the political spectrum
entry.summary: As political races heat up heading into the midterms, candidates from both parties are increasingly joining the fray to voice concerns over Flock surveillance cameras.

entry.title: Philippines Vice President Sara Duterte posts bail after arrest
entry.summary: Philippines Vice President Sara Duterte has posted bail after order issued for her arrest on charges she publicly threatened to arrange assassination of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and two others.

entry.title: The U.N. backs a new world map showing Africa in its true relative size
entry.summary: The U.N. has backed a new map showing Africa in its true relative size, with the U.S. standing alone in opposition.

entry.title: 4 things investigators learned about the dysfunction at Trump's Labor Department
entry.summary: A report from Labor Department investigators found former Labor Secretary Lori Chavez-DeRemer violated her own department's policy prohibiting harassment. She resigned in April.

entry.title: 'Hidden tribunals': Immigration court due process in tumult with new locations
entry.summary: The new effort appears to be another tactic in a broader Trump administration strategy to short-circuit immigrants' already limited due process options in order to speed deportations.

entry.title: 'The health system in Nepal is not prepared for this'
entry.summary: That's the grim assessment from the ground in the wake of the catastrophic flooding, which damaged or destroyed 7 health facilities, interrupted routine care and is affecting mental health.
